Complete your routine with PRANA’s Ashwagandha Day Moisturizer with Natural UV Protection, infused with adaptogenic ashwagandha, licorice extract, and natural UV-shielding ingredients like red raspberry seed oil. This lightweight, non-greasy cream hydrates, firms, and protects against sun damage and environmental stressors, leaving skin soft and radiant all day.

Elevate your glow with PRANA’s Saffron Brightening Serum, our best-seller powered by Fair Trade saffron, rich in crocin and crocetin. This lightweight serum evens skin tone, reduces hyperpigmentation, and hydrates deeply, delivering visible radiance in 2-4 weeks. Blended with skin-loving botanicals, it’s a gentle, vegan solution for a luminous complexion.
 

How to Use: After cleansing, apply 2-3 drops to your palm. Gently massage into your face and neck using upward strokes. Use morning and evening for optimal brightening and hydration.

Benefits: Fades dark spots, boosts radiance, and hydrates without irritation, ideal for all skin types.
settings.ggSrtJpO9ha_text:
Begin your nighttime ritual by gently cleansing away the day’s impurities with PRANA’s Rose & Jasmine Face Cleanser. Infused with soothing rose and jasmine, this toxin-free cleanser refreshes your skin while maintaining its natural moisture balance. Its gentle formula calms irritation and preps your skin for optimal absorption, ensuring a clean canvas for the next steps.

  • How to Use: Wet your face and neck. Dispense 2-3 pumps into your palm, gently massage in circular motions focusing on the T-zone, and rinse with warm water. Pat dry. Use daily for a refreshed, hydrated glow.
  • Benefits: Removes dirt and oil without stripping, soothes sensitive skin, and promotes a radiant complexion with Ayurvedic botanicals.
